With the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) set to meet in the middle of June, prediction markets offer options for users to weigh in as to when the next rate hike will be. ## Odds for Next Fed Rate Hike: Financial Prediction Markets. The question is when the Fed might hike rates and how much Trump (and Warsh) will try to stick to their preference for lower rates. As for the end of the year, those involved in this market are more enthusiastic that there will be a rate hike, but not overtly so.
In his first public remarks since stepping down as Fed chair, Powell says the central bank is undergoing a "stress test."

‘Fed Is Undergoing A Stress Test…’ Jerome Powell Issues Blunt Warning For America Amid Trump Turmoil
Hook Global

In a powerful speech, Former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell warned that undermining the central bank's political independence would destroy its hard-won credibility and harm the U.S. economy. Speaking at a JFK Library event, he reflected on JFK’s legacy of public service and integrity, arguing that the Fed’s legal protections against political removal are essential for stable policy. He stressed that while partisan differences are normal, Americans must unite behind core principles like the rule of law to preserve democratic institutions.
